claims: Artemis II is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on Friday, April 10, 2026.
Artemis II is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (00:07 GMT on April 11).
Artemis II follows a 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
Recovery teams will retrieve the crew from the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II landing time is approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (17:07 PDT).
NASA+ and YouTube will provide live streaming starting around 6:30 p.m. ET.
Artemis III is planned to land astronauts on the Moon in mid-2027.
Artemis IV is planned to land astronauts on the Moon in early 2028.
The April 10 splashdown marks the safe return of the first crewed mission to the vicinity of the Moon in over 50 years.
